nodes.label: getFromDirectory
nodes.rationale: Maps a URL onto a directory tree backend-agnostically, with or without a route prefix. Conditional requests use a weak ETag (size + mtime) and Last-Modified, a single bytes= range yields 206 or 416, a directory without a trailing slash 301-redirects to add it (query preserved), and HEAD returns full headers with no file read.

nodes.label: getFromBrowseableDirectory
nodes.rationale: Adds HTML directory listings, which escape filenames with the same html/escapeHtml helpers. Enable browsing only for internal tools - a public listing exposes the directory structure.

nodes.label: Path-traversal defence
nodes.rationale: The URL remainder is fully decoded before validation - peeling every encoding layer - and then each segment is rejected if it is .., empty, a NUL, a backslash, or a ':' segment (Windows drive / NTFS alternate data stream); absolute forms are refused and the joined path confined to the root. Dotfiles are denied by default.

nodes.label: Symlink confinement
nodes.rationale: Confinement is checked on every filesystem hop a request touches, not only the path the URL resolved to: a directory's index file and each entry of a browsable listing are canonicalised as well. An escaping link is a 404 whether asked for directly or reached as index.html, and it is left out of the listing entirely - its name, size and mtime are exactly what the policy withholds.

nodes.label: Uniform 404 for every rejection
nodes.rationale: Every rejected path returns the same 404 so the layer never reveals what exists. Bodies are buffered in memory bounded by maxFileSize (50 MiB, larger gets 413), which keeps serving identical across Bun, Node and Deno; range requests slice the buffer. There is no HOCON layer for static settings because an HTTP handler has no ActorSystem at request time.
